column4: Perlita duplicates n064 (珍珠), already verified with that exact nickname; Perlina keeps the pearl/bead sense (珠 bead/pearl) with a different diminutive, unused elsewhere, no bad connotation
Gotita duplicates n119 (雨滴), already verified with that exact nickname; Chorrito (a little trickle/splash) keeps the drip/droplet sense without duplicating, common neutral word across Latin America
